description: This PHP class defines the EmpWorkExperienceDecorator, a decorator for handling or formatting employee work experience data within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for setting employee references, retrieving formatted start and end dates, and calculating the duration of work experience.

classes.name: EmpWorkExperienceDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmpWorkExperience entity, providing additional methods for data formatting and manipulation related to employee work experience.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the decorator with an EmpWorkExperience object.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Protected method returning the wrapped EmpWorkExperience object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the associated Employee entity based on the provided employee number.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the work experience as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the work experience as a string, or null if not set.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration of the work experience in years, rounded to one decimal place, or null if dates are missing.
